all.headline: Iran war live: Trump claims goals nearing completion, vows to ‘finish job’
all.description: Iran denies seeking a truce and keeps up counterattacks, as US-Israeli raids cause deaths and damage across the country.

all.headline: Magnitude 7.4 quake hits off Indonesia’s Ternate, tsunami warning lifted
all.description: The ​epicentre of the ⁠earthquake was about ⁠120km (75 miles) from Ternate, in Indonesia's North Maluku ‌province.

all.headline: FBI agents from US arrive in Cuba to probe lethal speedboat shooting
all.description: Trump administration has denied involvement after Cuban government says a boat of armed men tried to infiltrate island.

all.headline: First troops from UN-backed Gang Suppression Force arrive in Haiti
all.description: The force has an initial mandate of 12 months to address widespread gang violence in Haiti ahead of its elections.

all.headline: Watch the moment Artemis II launches historic mission around the moon
all.description: NASA successfully launched four astronauts into space on Wednesday evening, for a 10-day flight to the moon.

all.headline: NASA successfully launches historic Artemis II moon mission
all.description: The mission is a major step in NASA’s plan to return humans to the moon and eventually send astronauts to Mars.

all.headline: US removes sanctions on Venezuela’s interim President Delcy Rodriguez
all.description: US has exerted growing influence over the Venezuelan government after abducting former President Nicolas Maduro.

all.headline: NASA moon mission a ‘contrast’ to US war on Iran, says US senator
all.description: Astronauts have boarded NASA’s Orion capsule as they prepare for the first crewed lunar mission in more than 50 years.

all.headline: SpaceX files to go public, paving way to make Elon Musk first trillionaire
all.description: Company has captured public attention through vast network of satellites and focus on space exploration.

all.headline: Smoke and embers seen over Iran’s Isfahan after strike
all.description: Video captured a massive column of smoke and burning embers towering over Isfahan, Iran following a US-Israeli strike.
